title: Directed affine global-section continuity with Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], J a small nonempty directed preorder, D:J^op -> Sch a diagram of affine schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and c a limiting cone. Let pi:D -> const S be a compatible family of structure maps to an affine scheme S and p:c.pt -> S their limit map. For a small-etale A-valued sheaf G on S [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], consider any supplied diagram H:J -> A identified objectwise with Gamma(D_j, pi_j^* G) [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor]. Assume its transitions are the adjunction-unit global-section maps followed by inverse-image composition. Let K be a supplied cocone whose point is identified with Gamma(c.pt, p^* G) and whose legs are those same canonical maps for the cone projections. Then K is a colimit. The normalization equalities and all their directions are exactly those in the Lean statement.

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 2: finite skeleton descent and finite-cochain section continuity; explicit categorical construction with Grothendieck coefficients.

external.place: Tag 09YQ, degree zero (abelian coefficients); arbitrary Grothendieck coefficients by the categorical finite-matching argument stated in the proof

proof.text: For abelian-group coefficients apply globalSections_limit_comparison. Stage representatives prove surjectivity of colimit.desc, and eventual vanishing proves its kernel zero. Thus colimit.desc is an isomorphism and the normalized supplied cocone is a colimit.

For module coefficients use forget_2 to abelian groups and its coinduction right adjoint. Apply the coefficient/pullback section comparison to the supplied object and cocone-point isomorphisms. The preceding abelian-group result gives a colimit after forgetting; reflect it to modules.

Choose a separator T of A. Use Mathlib GabrielPopescu.full and GabrielPopescu.preservesFiniteLimits for tensorObj T left adjoint to preadditiveCoyonedaObj T. Objectwise application of the fully faithful right adjoint gives a module-valued sheaf M. The sheaf adjunction counit identifies L#M with G. This is a real constructed lift, not arbitrary data selected from an existence claim.

Form the canonical module-valued diagram of pullback sections and its cone-point cocone using rho. Its functor and cocone laws are rho identity/composition. The module result makes it colimiting. The exact left adjoint preserves its colimit. Affine coefficient comparison and the counit give a diagram isomorphism to H and a point isomorphism to K. Their naturality is precisely the proved coefficient normalization and rho sheaf naturality, followed by hH and hK. Transport this colimit along both isomorphisms to obtain IsColimit K.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YQ degree zero via the proved scalar comparison; general coefficients by the exact Gabriel-Popescu localization in Mathlib, with the affine finite-matching coefficient comparison proved by A4 on 2026-10-16.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_globalSections_limit_isColimit_of_directed
    {J : Type u} [Preorder J] [IsDirected J (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty J] {S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsAffine S]
    (D : Jᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j)]
    (π : D ⟶ (Functor.const Jᵒᵖ).obj S) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (p : c.pt ⟶ S) (hp : ∀ j : J, p = c.π.app (op j) ≫ π.app (op j))
    (G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A) (H : J ⥤ A)
    (e : ∀ j : J, H.obj j ≅ (Sheaf.Γ (D.obj (op j)).smallEtaleTopology A).obj
      ((upperStar A (π.app (op j))).obj G))
    (hH : ∀ (j k : J) (f : j ⟶ k), H.map f ≫ (e k).hom =
      (e j).hom ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap A (D.map f.op)
        ((upperStar A (π.app (op j))).obj G) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ (D.obj (op k)).smallEtaleTopology A).map
        ((upperStarComp A (D.map f.op) (π.app (op j)) (π.app (op k))
          (by simpa only [Functor.const_obj_obj, Functor.const_obj_map,
            Category.comp_id] using (π.naturality f.op).symm)).inv.app G))
    (K : Cocone H) (eK : K.pt ≅ (Sheaf.Γ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology A).obj
      ((upperStar A p).obj G))
    (hK : ∀ j : J, K.ι.app j ≫ eK.hom =
      (e j).hom ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap A (c.π.app (op j))
        ((upperStar A (π.app (op j))).obj G) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology A).map
        ((upperStarComp A (c.π.app (op j)) (π.app (op j)) p (hp j)).inv.app G)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit K)
